channel.title: D2 Item of the Day
channel.description: One rare Diablo 2 collector's item every day.

item.title: Silks of the Victor
item.description:
Silks of the Victor
classic caster armor

Rarity: Uncommon

Plus one to all skills on a body armor sounds ordinary now. In classic Diablo 2 it was a grail. There was no Enigma, no Vipermagi, no Spirit Shroud, and almost nothing gave skills. A caster who wanted a skill level on the chest slot had this and little else, which is exactly why a plain unique Ancient Armor was the best caster body in the game for a stretch.

item.title: Storm Circlet
item.description:
Storm Circlet
two-class hacked amulet

Rarity: Mythic

An amulet can grant skills to one class. This one grants two, plus two necromancer and plus two sorceress on the same neck, with cast rate and resists piled on. No random roll produces class bonuses for two classes at once. It reads as an ordinary godly rare until you notice it is helping two characters who could never both wear it.

item.title: 1.08 Hellmouth
item.description:
1.08 Hellmouth
cannot be frozen on gloves

Rarity: Very Rare

Cannot be frozen normally costs a ring, and Raven Frost is the ring you spend it on. These gloves carry it outright. In 1.08 that handed a melee character the whole ring slot back, and no glove in the game has done it since. The meteor proc and the fire damage are decoration next to that one line.

item.title: Ogre Gauntlets
item.description:
Ogre Gauntlets
hacked god gloves

Rarity: Mythic

A plain white pair of gloves, no name, no prefix, wearing stats the slot cannot hold. A hundred attack speed and a hundred hit recovery, ninety dexterity, ninety vitality, a full hundred to every resistance, and a weapon's damage roll bolted on. Hold each line against what gloves actually roll and every one is over the ceiling. It is the White Ring's edit on a different slot.

item.title: Pain Hood
item.description:
Pain Hood
2/20 druid circlet

Rarity: Very Rare

The best caster helm for a druid is often not a unique but a rare circlet like this. Two to all druid skills and twenty faster cast are the two lines every caster hunts, and here they arrive with run speed, dexterity and all four resistances on one Tiara. No unique druid helm matches the spread. A random yellow name hiding one of the best helms a storm or fire druid can wear.

item.title: Occy Ring
item.description:
Occy Ring
bugged Stone of Jordan

Rarity: Mythic

Read the stats, then read the item type. Those are The Oculus's stats, a sorceress orb, sitting on a ring. Three sorceress skills, thirty faster cast, teleport when struck, all in a slot that should never hold them. A sorceress wearing one carried an extra orb's worth of power for free.

item.title: Cruel Matriarchal Bow of Amplify Damage
item.description:
Cruel Matriarchal Bow of Amplify Damage
hacked amp bow

Rarity: Mythic

It calls itself a magic bow, but a magic item gets one prefix and one suffix, two lines at most. This has a curse on striking, a class skill, thirty attack speed and three hundred seventy six enhanced damage all at once. That is several affixes too many. It is a hacked bow wearing a legal-looking blue name, which is what made this kind so hard to catch in a trade window.
